stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the 5-minute window ending 2026-11-03T19:51:22Z, the only checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR series above zero is oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart at ~1.25 spans; oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct all show 0.
Checkout's error-span ratio for the 5-minute bucket ending 19:51:22 is 0.0286, while the 10-minute buckets covering 18:11:22 to 19:51:22 range from 0.0745 to 0.1324.

Across the hour ending 19:51:22, checkout's per-minute ERROR-span increases are dominated by oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with identical values at every timestamp (e.g. 10.0 at 19:05:22 and 19:15:22, 8.75 at 19:17:22 and 19:27:22, tapering to 3.75 at 19:49:22 and 0 at 19:50:22 and 19:51:22), and the same values appear on payment's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge.

Checkout's client calls to payment (rpc_method Charge) returned rpc_grpc_status_code 2 (UNKNOWN) on 5.56 of 10.0 calls in the 10 minutes ending 19:51:22, and on 36-75% of Charge calls in each 10-minute bucket between 18:11:22 and 19:41:22, while status 2 was 0 in every bucket from 16:31:22 through 18:01:22 and from 13:51:22 through 15:11:22.

Checkout client-side p95 latency by rpc_method in the window ending 19:50:22 is Charge 22.75 ms, Convert 4.75 ms, EmptyCart 9.5 ms, GetCart 4.75 ms, GetProduct 4.75 ms, GetQuote 9.5 ms, ShipOrder 4.75 ms; the hour's values for the same series stayed within 4.75-85 ms (Charge), 46.25 ms (EmptyCart) and 43.75 ms (GetQuote).

Checkout server-side p95 (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket) at 19:50:22 is 72.5 ms versus an hour range of 37.5-212.5 ms, and product-catalog server p95 is 4.82 ms versus a flat 4.75 ms all hour.

Cart shows exactly one error span in the last 5 minutes: POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 1.25 in the bucket ending 19:51:22, mirrored by checkout's client oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 1.25, and 0 in all five preceding 5-minute buckets from 19:21:22 to 19:49:22.

For the hour ending 19:51:22 the ERROR-status query over currency, shipping, email, cart and product-catalog returned series only for cart (0 until the final bucket, 1.11 in the 10 minutes ending 19:51:22) and product-catalog (0 throughout); no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series were returned for currency, shipping or email.

rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket has service_name values only ad, checkout and product-catalog in the last 5 minutes, so payment, cart, currency, shipping and email expose no server-side latency series.

app_payment_transactions_total in the last 5 minutes carries labels app_payment_currency (USD 2.4999, CAD 0) and pod/deployment labels, but no outcome or status label, so it cannot separate successful from failed charges.

The deepest cause reachable is payment: checkout's Charge client spans carry gRPC status 2 and payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries the same error counts, so PlaceOrder failures follow failed Charge calls. Whether status 2 originates in payment's decline/validation logic, an injected fault, or a payment runtime error cannot be determined from metrics alone.

The Charge status-2 failures are episodic rather than a single onset: zero before 15:11, present 15:21-16:21, zero 16:31-18:01, and present again from 18:11 through the current window, consistent with a repeating synthetic/fault-injection pattern rather than monotonic degradation.

Rejected: a latency regression in checkout or its dependencies during the last 5 minutes. Checkout client p95 per method, checkout server p95 and product-catalog server p95 all sit within or below their hour-long ranges.

Rejected: product-catalog as a cause of checkout errors. Checkout's GetProduct client calls show rpc_grpc_status_code 13 count 0 in every 10-minute bucket of the hour, and product-catalog ERROR-span increases are 0 throughout.

Counter-evidence to the reported 'elevated errors' in the last 5 minutes: checkout's 5-minute error ratio (0.0286) and its 10-minute ratio (0.0946) are at the low end of, not above, the 0.0745-0.1324 band observed across the preceding 10-minute buckets of the same hour.

gaps: Jaeger trace search was unavailable throughout: traces_search returned status error / SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on six attempts (checkout over 19:46-19:51, payment over 19:49-19:51, and other windows), so no trace ids, no parent-child call edges and no error detail text could be retrieved; the requested trace ids are therefore not available.

The payment server-latency query returned status no_data (view dca1cf80-dc46-4e09-8ed4-686cb1f64a98-t1:e21834f0-8975-4cbf-ad47-b98af53ec16e), and rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket has no series for payment, cart, currency, shipping or email, so their server-side latency is unknown rather than zero; latency findings rest only on checkout's client-observed spans.
The payment-side message behind gRPC status 2 on Charge is unknown; no span error detail, pod logs or change history are available in this Run.
app_payment_transactions_total has no outcome/failure label, so payment decline versus success cannot be measured from it.
kube-state-metrics (restarts, ReplicaSet/image changes), pod logs and change history are listed as not integrated in this Run, so any change during the window could not be checked.
Whether the recurring Charge failures relate to email latency or failures could not be assessed: email has no rpc_server latency series and no error series were returned for it.
next_steps: Once Jaeger is reachable, pull failing checkout PlaceOrder traces and inspect the oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge child span's status message to capture the exact status-2 diagnostic text and cite trace ids.

Review payment service logs/configuration for the decline or fault-injection path that produces gRPC status 2 on Charge, and compare the 15:21-16:21 and 18:11-19:51 episodes with the quiet 16:31-18:01 interval.
Confirm whether the single EmptyCart error at ~19:51 on cart's POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart is an independent failure or an artifact of the checkout flow.
Add server-side latency instrumentation for payment, cart, currency, shipping and email so their own p95 can be compared against a baseline instead of relying on checkout's client spans.
